user.title: Hisense AX5125H Soundbar
user.description: Pick the CEC transport the integration will use to talk to the soundbar.

esphome_mqtt.title: ESPHome CEC gateway (MQTT)
esphome_mqtt.description: MQTT topics of the ESPHome hdmi-cec-gateway. Requires the MQTT integration to be set up in HA.

data.bus_log_switch: Switch entity “CEC Bus Log Enabled” (auto-enable; without it the gateway does not publish rx)

esphome.title: ESPHome CEC gateway (native API)
esphome.description: Service esphome.<name>_cec_send. For full functionality (EZPlay as TV) the gateway needs the cec_send_src action.

pycec_tcp.title: pyCEC TCP bridge (libcec remote)
pycec_tcp.description: Connect to a pyCEC server (python3 -m pycec) running on a machine with a CEC adapter.

libcec.title: libcec (local adapter)
libcec.description: Requires the system python module cec (libcec) on the HA machine — does not work on HAOS without it.

common.title: CEC bus parameters
common.description: Defaults match the usual topology: TV=0, soundbar (AudioSystem)=5, gateway=0xE, Kodi behind the soundbar HDMI IN at 3.1.0.0.

data.hdmi_pa: Physical address of HDMI IN (for switching to HDMI)

error.mqtt_missing: The MQTT integration is not configured in HA.
error.esphome_services_missing: No esphome.*_cec_send service found — set up the ESPHome integration first.
error.poll_too_fast: Minimum poll interval is 10 s (be kind to the CEC bus).
error.no_response: Soundbar did not answer — check that the CEC bus log is enabled, the addresses are right and the soundbar is on.

abort.already_configured: This transport + address combination is already configured.

send_raw.name: Send raw CEC frame
send_raw.description: Sends an arbitrary CEC frame through the integration transport. Guard rails: destructive subopcodes (A6/B0/B2) and a bare A2 are rejected.
